prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet Choice Split Comparison Stage: Redesign the pet choice screen using a split layout to clearly present pre-made companion selection versus custom generation side-by-side.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a ready-to-adopt companion or upload photos to craft your own."}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post Companion Selection Sign-In Reorder: Move sign-in directly after companion selection so users pick their pet before creating or logging into an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [home, new_screen] Desktop Companion Render Status Screen: Insert a new screen after waiting to explicitly confirm desktop render readiness and visual asset generation before entering home.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_readiness", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_readiness": {"headline": "Preparing Desktop Companion", "body": "Rendering pet visuals and checking system desktop integration...", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "progress", "label": "Rendering companion visual elements"}]}}
3: [finish, new_flow] Pet Control Mode Setup Flow: Add an interaction choice component on the final screen allowing users to pick how they prefer to interact with their pet on desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Choose Preferred Companion Mode", "body": "Select how your pet behaves on your desktop screen.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Interaction Mode Select"}]}}
4: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Status Progress Tips: Show progress indicators and detailed progress tips during pet generation on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Creating Your Unique Pet", "body": "Our engine is building custom animations and behaviors.", "show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10}}
5: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Mode Guidance Hint: Provide a helpful hint on path selection explaining that chosen preferences can be changed later in app settings.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Don't worry—you can adjust your path or switch modes anytime in settings."}}
6: [home, notification] Background Processing Desktop Alert: Enable desktop notification alerts when companion rendering completes on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "You can minimize this window. We will alert you when your pet lands on your desktop!"}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Companion Trait Choice Reward Badge: Display a dynamic trait verification badge on the adoption certificate screen celebrating pet registration.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your companion is officially registered with special starter personality traits!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Official Adoption Verified", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [sign_in, copy] Account Sync Reassurance Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize that signing in backs up pet data and prevents companion resets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Save & Protect Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Sign in to back up your pet data safely and prevent companion reset across sessions."}}
9: [choose_path, layout] Two Column Path Selection Layout: Switch the choose path screen to a two-column layout for clearer side-by-side comparison of onboarding paths.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Select Your Desktop Companion Path"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the pick_friend screen layout inside onboarding is allowed and preserves its core job.
Reordering sign-in within onboarding is explicitly permitted.
Adding a new readiness screen inside onboarding before home intro is allowed.
Adding an interaction choice component to the home intro screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding real wait progress indicators and tips to the waiting screen is allowed.
Adding guidance hints to the choose_path screen is allowed.
Enabling completion notification alerts on the waiting screen is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions rewards/free extras ('special starter personality traits').
Updating sign-in copy to explain data protection without dark patterns or rule violations is allowed.
Redesigning choose_path with a two-column layout is allowed and preserves choice options.
